children: Spain's European Union-harmonised 12-month inflation rate rose to 4.5% in August from 3.9% in the period through July, mainly due to higher fuel prices, preliminary data from the National Statistics Institute (INE) showed on Friday.
That was below the 4.6% expected by analysts polled by Reuters.
Core inflation, which strips out volatile fresh food and energy prices, was 2.9% year-on-year, the INE data showed.
Spain's 12-month national inflation rose to 4.3%, up from 3.6% in July. Analysts polled by Reuters had expected a 4.2% rate.
